name: Pilot Stonegear
summary: Pilot Stonegear, nicknamed 'Stone', is a dwarf mechanic and driver in the Ironforge Siege Brigade stationed at Steelgrill's Depot. He operates the formidable siege engine known as Trollplow and works tirelessly to enhance its performance and armor. Adventurers traveling through Dun Morogh often help him secure rare materials to keep his war machine battle-ready.

sections.title: Master of the Trollplow
sections.body: Stationed among the rumbling boilers and clanking tracks of Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear serves Ironforge as a proud driver in the Siege Brigade. His pride and joy is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to smash through enemy lines. Stonegear takes his machine seriously—knowing that in the heat of battle, a driver's life depends entirely on the resilience of gears, plates, and steam pressure. He constantly seeks to fine-tune both Trollplow's combat efficiency and the everyday livability of its cramped cockpit.

sections.title: Tinkering and Metallurgy
sections.body: Like many dwarven and gnomish grease-monkeys at the depot, Stonegear is rarely content with factory specifications. He often spends off-duty hours debating engineering schematics with comrades like Pilot Bellowfiz and Pilot Hammerfoot. Whether chasing down rumors of exotic ores or tracking down volatile minerals to fuel enhanced plating and munitions, Stonegear relies on eager recruits to venture into the snowy wilderness and dangerous caves of Dun Morogh on supply runs.

faq.answer: Pilot Stonegear, often called 'Stone', is an Ironforge dwarf and member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade. He is stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, where he maintains and operates his siege engine, the Trollplow.
Stonegear is located just outside Kharanos at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, surrounded by siege tanks, spare parts, and fellow pilots.

The Trollplow is Pilot Stonegear's personal siege engine. He constantly works to upgrade its mechanical reliability, armor plating, and internal comfort so it can survive the brutal demands of front-line combat.

faq.q: What does Stonegear need adventurers for?
faq.answer: Stonegear enlists travelers to scout nearby threats and collect rare minerals—such as incendicite ore—to help upgrade and maintain the Siege Brigade's heavy war machinery.

faq.q: Who does Pilot Stonegear work with?
faq.answer: He serves in the Ironforge Siege Brigade alongside other renowned drivers like Pilot Bellowfiz and Pilot Hammerfoot, frequently debating mechanical upgrades and machine designs with them at the depot.

faq.q: What is the Ironforge Siege Brigade?
faq.answer: The Ironforge Siege Brigade is the mechanized armor division of the dwarven military. Operating steam tanks, siege engines, and heavy artillery, they provide armored support to defend Dun Morogh and project Ironforge's military might across Khaz Modan.

angles.text: Stonegear exemplifies the dwarven love for heavy steel, roaring engines, and crushing mountain foes under massive iron treads.
Gnomes working alongside the Siege Brigade find a kindred spirit in Stonegear, who is always eager to tinker with experimental designs and optimize output.
Engineers can appreciate Stonegear's dedication to field-modifying the Trollplow, balancing deadly combat performance with pilot ergonomics.
Miners provide the vital raw ores and volatile subterranean deposits Stonegear requires to forge reinforced plating and munitions.
